what: A background-colored curtain covering the screen and a 20% faint mark (logo) in the center are hidden behind a 200%-height gradient mask. Once the font arrives, .05s later the mask rises and the curtain is revealed from the bottom, dragging a soft edge, and lifts upward (mark 1s · curtain .2s later 3.375s, curve 0.19,1,0.22,1) — it opens like mist with no sharp edge. Clicking a same-site link uses the reverse mask: the curtain fills in softly from the bottom and covers in .9s (mark .2s later), then navigates .45s after

options.in: Time in seconds for the curtain to lift on the opened page, default 3.375 — almost all of the screen shows within the first 1s (the curve is front-loaded)
options.delay: Wait before the curtain clears (s), default .2 — the indicator clears first
options.cover: Seconds the curtain takes to cover after a link is pressed, default .9
options.mark-delay: Delay before showing when covering (s), default .2
options.go: Seconds from clicking a link to navigating, default .45 — it navigates before the cover finishes, so only the early part of the curve (almost fully covered) shows. Set close to 0 for app-like frequent navigation
options.wait: Longest time to wait for the font (seconds), default 2
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: (if present) a faint mark standing at the center of the veil (logo text or SVG) — the part clones it into both veils
options.--fx-veil: (css variable) overlay color, default background color
options.on: When to start lifting the curtain — by default when fonts are ready (at most wait seconds), ‹load› means window load, ‹ready› means right away (for when the curtain stays too long on a skin that loads web fonts late · brand copy)

use: BRAND… — Opened pages clear once the font arrives, and same-site links navigate after a curtain covers the screen.

from.where: Body of every page (data-fx · center logo .rb-mask-mark) — original Transition · transitionmask: intro maskwipein logo 1s · mask 3.375s .2s late, outro maskwipeout .9s · logo .2s late, navigate after 450ms)

note: Curtains and reveals move only by mask and run as CSS animations without GSAP, so they don’t stutter even while heavy scripts run. When the wipe ends, the curtain folds to width 0 to clear clicks. Even before the part attaches the curtain, the ::after of [data-fx] elements covers with the background color from the first paint (if the script doesn’t run, it lifts after 3 seconds).
